name: Zine Collage
tagline: ravyn's collage: a zine diorama — halftone, red-channel split, Anton mega numbers, Montserrat caps on a yellow pill, cuts every 0.6 s.

motion.direction: ravyn `collage`. A zine diorama: halftone over everything, walls in `mar` / `goldd` / `ter`, Anton MEGA numbers (up to 600 px) as `counter`s, Montserrat 800 caps captions on a yellow `gold` pill 154 px tall at y 1458. Hard cuts about every 0.6 s; the camera never stops (slow pull-back); every move lands in held poses (stop-motion). Taped `imageCard`s, a `stamp` on verdicts, a `bleedPlate` for the big claim. Loud and physical; nothing fades.
